findings.issue: SECURITY DEFINER functions missing SET search_path — 4 functions affected
findings.impact: Search_path injection attack: user-created objects can hijack elevated privileges
findings.fix: Add SET search_path = 'public' to handle_new_user(), handle_new_channel(), handle_new_workspace(), and the fixed version in migration 22

findings.issue: Missing INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RLS policies for workspace_members and channel_members tables
findings.impact: Direct user operations on member tables bypass RLS — relies entirely on application-level middleware
findings.fix: Add INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for workspace_members and channel_members with auth.uid() checks

findings.issue: TypeScript types significantly out of sync with database schema — 6 types defined vs 16 tables exist
findings.impact: Type safety gaps: developers referencing missing types will fall back to any; soft-delete fields (deleted_at, archived_at) missing from Workspace, Channel, Message types
findings.fix: Run npx supabase gen types typescript --local > packages/db/src/types.ts; verify all tables represented

findings.issue: Migration sequence gap in 20260626 batch — jumps from 01 to 22 with 21 missing sequence numbers
findings.impact: Suggests migrations were deleted or renumbered; Supabase CLI tracking by filename may conflict
findings.fix: Audit migration sequence; create placeholder files or renumber to eliminate gaps

findings.issue: Webhook_endpoints.created_by FK has no ON DELETE action — defaults to RESTRICT
findings.impact: Deleting an auth user who created webhooks will fail with FK violation
findings.fix: Add ON DELETE SET NULL or ON DELETE CASCADE to webhook_endpoints.created_by FK constraint

findings.issue: Runbook incorrectly states 'PostgreSQL does not support transactional DDL rollback'
findings.impact: Misguided operator guidance — DDL inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK IS supported, preventing safe rollback
findings.fix: Correct the runbook: PostgreSQL fully supports DDL rollback within transaction blocks

findings.issue: Missing index on reactions.message_id — all reaction queries filter by message_id
findings.impact: Full table scans on reaction queries for channels with many messages and reactions

findings.issue: Missing index on notifications.workspace_id — workspace-level notification queries
findings.impact: Full table scans for workspace notification listing

findings.issue: Seed data contains plaintext webhook secrets visible in repository
findings.impact: Development secrets committed to git — if repository access is compromised, secrets are exposed
findings.fix: Remove hardcoded secrets from seed files; use placeholder values like 'CHANGE_ME'

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts exist for any of the 26 migrations
findings.impact: Rollback requires manual SQL construction per incident or PITR with data loss
findings.fix: Write .down.sql reversal scripts for each migration, starting with the last 5 additive-column migrations

findings.issue: Dual migration application paths: supabase db execute (dev scripts) vs supabase db push (CI)
findings.impact: Different code paths may produce different results — db push uses migration tracking, db execute runs raw SQL
findings.fix: Standardize on supabase db push for all environments; remove db execute fallback path
